name: confetti
title: Confetti
description: Bursts of tumbling paper confetti with real physics (gravity, drag, wobble): a basic pop, fireworks, side cannons, stars or emoji, fired at chosen times.

moworks.author: magicui
moworks.call: MW.confetti(q(".mw-confetti"), tl, 0, { bursts: [{ at: 0.3, options: { particleCount: 160, spread: 90, startVelocity: 55, origin: { x: 0.5, y: 0.65 }, scalar: 1.6 } }, { at: 2.6, recipe: "stars" }, { at: 4.2, recipe: "side-cannons" }], hold: 8 });

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked
credit.upstream: canvas-confetti 1.9.3 (Kiril Vatev, ISC): its particle physics re-written with a seeded generator

moworks.notes: el is a full-frame <canvas>. bursts: [{ at, recipe | options }] in s after `at`; options are canvas-confetti's (particleCount, angle, spread, startVelocity, decay, gravity, drift, ticks, origin {x, y}, colors, shapes, scalar, flat). canvas-confetti's random size jitter per tick is seeded too.
